# Clovely

> Clovely is a personality-first, voice-led dating app for people who want a long-term relationship, paired with a licensed relationship coach.

Clovely matches people in their mid-20s to 40s on personality, values and life goals instead of photos. Every match begins with a voice note; photos stay hidden until both people agree to reveal them. Matching draws on decades of relationship research, and every member gets a relationship coach for check-ins, private messaging and virtual or in-person sessions.

## Key facts

- Category: dating and relationships app (iOS, coming soon)
- Audience: adults in their mid-20s to 40s seeking a long-term relationship
- Approach: voice-led first impressions, values and life-goal compatibility, conflict-repair coaching
- Differentiator: photos unlock only by mutual reveal; every member is photo and voice verified
- Coaching: gentle check-ins, private text access to a coach, virtual or in-person sessions with a licensed relationship coach
- Tagline: Finding depth through luck and love
